description: This file is a server-side PHP template for rendering an administrative interface for managing 'nodes'. It generates HTML with embedded PHP code to display filters, a list of nodes, and associated actions.

methods.name: layout
methods.description: Sets the layout template for the current view.

methods.name: section
methods.description: Defines a content section within the layout.

methods.name: replace
methods.description: Replaces or ends the current section, allowing nested templates.

methods.name: text
methods.description: Fetches localized text or translation strings.
